categories.main_business_segments: Shibaura Machine operates three main business segments: Molding Machines (including injection molding machines, die casting machines, and extrusion machines), Machine Tools (including general and ultra-precision machine tools), and Control Machines (including industrial robots and electronic control devices). The company also has a minor 'Other' segment, which includes welfare services and environmental measurement equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing and engineering technologies, such as high-speed and high-precision machining, intelligent control systems, energy-saving solutions, and automation. Key production methods include the development of electric and hydraulic molding machines, precision machining centers, and integration of IoT and robotics for factory automation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shibaura Machine primarily serves manufacturers in the automotive, electronics, energy, medical, and packaging industries. Major end markets include automotive parts suppliers, battery and energy storage manufacturers, optical and semiconductor equipment makers, and general industrial manufacturers requiring high-precision machinery.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with significant operations in Japan, China, India, Southeast Asia (notably Thailand and Singapore), North America (USA), and Europe (recently expanding in Germany). Overseas sales account for over 77% of total revenue, with China, India, and the US being key markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shibaura Machine operates as an equipment and systems manufacturer, positioned midstream to downstream in the industrial supply chain. It supplies capital equipment and automation solutions to manufacturers, enabling their production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include portfolio transformation, direct sales and system engineering, ESG management, and digital transformation (DX). R&D focuses on high-precision, energy-efficient, and intelligent machinery, next-generation battery production systems, large-scale die casting for automotive 'gigacasting,' and solutions for renewable energy and productivity improvement. The company is also investing in alliances and M&A to enhance technology and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of industrial machinery and systems, including molding machines, machine tools, and control equipment. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services, maintenance, spare parts, and, to a lesser extent, equipment leasing and technical consulting.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global and Japanese machinery manufacturers such as FANUC, Nissei Plastic, Sumitomo Heavy Industries, and DMG Mori. Shibaura Machine is positioned as a leading supplier in the molding machine and large machine tool markets, with a strong presence in Asia and growing international competitiveness, especially in high-growth markets like India and China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 168.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 14.1 billion yen and net profit of 12.6 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profitability over the past several years, with a strategic target to achieve 200 billion yen in annual sales by FY2027 and 300 billion yen by 2030. Overseas sales are a major growth driver.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shibaura Machine differentiates itself through advanced engineering, high reliability, and the ability to deliver integrated, energy-efficient, and automated production solutions tailored to customer needs. The company emphasizes its global support network, ability to address megatrends such as electrification and sustainability, and its expertise in high-precision, large-scale, and intelligent manufacturing systems.
